thread:
maria-support: Hey team — customer org org_8421 reported they redeemed promo code via our CLI and got a 200 + email confirmation, but their account balance is still zero. Ticket #CS-5591. Promo: SUMMEREDGE2025. Customer provided transaction id txn_9f3b. Can someone check ledger mapping?

anil-eng: Copying this. First guess: either webhook ingestion to ledger failed or the credit wrote to the wrong billing account. Can you paste the exact CLI command they used?

maria-support: They used the CLI flow: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/redeem -d '{"org_id":"org_8421","code":"SUMMEREDGE2025"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'` — response: `{
  "status":"accepted",
  "id":"txn_9f3b",
  "amount":5000
}` and the user got an email: "Your promo was applied."

promo-bot: Event: `promo.redeemed` received for org_id=org_8421, txn=txn_9f3b, amt=5000. Delivery: webhook->ledger-service queued.

devon-billing: I looked up txn_9f3b in the ingest queue. We have an entry: `ingest_event(txn_9f3b) status=processed timestamp=1709506001` but ledger shows no credit row for org_8421. There is, however, a credit row with amount=5000 attached to billing_account=b_ghost_mig_17.

maria-support: b_ghost_mig_17? Customer says they never had a ghost billing account. They only have billing_account=b_main_8421.

anil-eng: That suggests migration-era placeholder mapping got used. During the org migration last month we created provisional billing blobs `b_ghost_*` for some orphaned orgs. If the webhook payload included `legacy_tenant_id` instead of `org_id`, ledger-service might have linked to the placeholder.

jenna-sre: Can you paste the raw webhook payload from our logs for txn_9f3b? I'll grep the logs.

promo-bot: Raw payload (sanitized): `{
  "event":"promo.redeemed",
  "org": { "id":"org_8421", "legacy_tenant":"tenant_8421_mig" },
  "txn_id":"txn_9f3b",
  "amount":5000
}`

anil-eng: Aha — ledger-service's reconciliation picks billing_account via tenant->billing map. If `tenant_8421_mig` is mapped to `b_ghost_mig_17` in the migration mapping table, that's where it landed.

devon-billing: Confirmed. In `tenant_billing_map` we have `tenant_8421_mig -> b_ghost_mig_17` (created 2024-11-02) and b_ghost_mig_17 is marked inactive. Looks like the ingest flow didn't prefer `org.id` over `legacy_tenant`. That's a bug.

maria-support: Customer is asking for a quick fix — they need credits available today. Any workaround to move the credit?

anil-eng: We can reassign the ledger entry to b_main_8421 with a small patch job: create a compensating transfer: insert row type=transfer from b_ghost_mig_17 -> b_main_8421 amount=5000 with note referencing txn_9f3b, then mark original entry as migrated. Need approval from billing to touch ledger.

devon-billing: I approve the compensating transfer. Please attach audit note and link to CS ticket. Also we need to update ingest logic to prefer `org.id` mapping.

jenna-sre: I'll run the migration script in staging first. Give me 30 mins to validate. Also adding an alert to detect future credits landing on inactive billing accounts.

maria-support: Thanks — I've told the customer we'll push a fix ASAP and gave them ETA 2 hours.

anil-eng: Running SQL (sanitized): ```
BEGIN;
INSERT INTO ledger (id, billing_account, amount, type, ref_txn, note, created_by) VALUES ('patch_9f3b_xfer','b_main_8421',5000,'transfer','txn_9f3b','reassign from b_ghost_mig_17 per CS-5591','ledger_patch_bot');
UPDATE ledger SET metadata = jsonb_set(coalesce(metadata,'{}'), '{migrated_from}', '"b_ghost_mig_17"') WHERE ref_txn = 'txn_9f3b';
COMMIT;
```

promo-bot: Ledger patched: inserted patch_9f3b_xfer id. Audit link: https://console.redwood.ai/ledger/patch_9f3b_xfer

devon-billing: Patch looks good. I've flagged tenant_billing_map entry `tenant_8421_mig` for deletion and created JIRA INF-3112 to ensure ingest logic ignores legacy tenant when org.id is present.

maria-support: I just confirmed with the customer — balance updated to 5000 and they can now allocate credits. Customer says "thanks, huge help" :thumbsup:

jenna-sre: Alert rule created: `credits_to_inactive_billing > 0` will fire if any credit posts to an inactive billing account. Also added integration test in ledger-service PR #992 to prefer org.id over legacy tenant id.

anil-eng: Closing loop: root cause = migration-era tenant mapping overshadowing explicit org.id in webhook payload. Fixes: 1) immediate ledger patch (applied), 2) ingest code change (PR open), 3) alert and test (done), 4) clean up tenant_billing_map entries (billing team).

maria-support: Resolved for CS-5591, customer notified and happy. Leaving thread open for the follow-up JIRA INF-3112.

devon-billing: FYI I've scheduled a billing data audit next week to find other credits that might have landed on ghost accounts.

maria-support: Thanks everyone!"
